title_o: Predicting Performance in a Community College Content-Area Course from Academic Skill Level

replications.journal: Community College Journal of Research and Practice
replications.quote: Over all, this study found similar results to the study previously done by Goldstein and Perin (2008). This successful replication’s findings are in accordance with, and expand upon, the original findings for Goldstein and Perin (2008), lending further validity to this body of literature.
